Calculate the energy cost per kWhr for a power station having the following data: 12   
Installed capacity of the plant= 120 MW, Capital cost= Tk. 35 crores, rate of interest= 8.5%, rate   
of depreciation = 7%, annual cost of fuel = Tk. 28 lacs, salaries and taxation = Tk. IO lacs. annual   
load factor= 60%.   
Also calculate the increase of cost per kWhr if the annual load factor decreases to 45%.
